name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Tauri 2 desktop shell that hosts the dsh web profile in a native window

scripts.bundle: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs --check && node scripts/build-bridge.mjs && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p bridge-client/tsconfig.tests.json && pnpm exec vitest --config bridge-client/vitest.config.ts run && node scripts/bake-runtime.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node-sidecar.mjs && tauri build --ci
